443:t_2:192.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「There's no way the Wingless could bear the weight of the truth.」

443:t_2:193.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That's right... The moment you learn it, you'll be trapped in the Heavenly Prison...」

443:t_2:195.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... Shall we play for a little while?」

443:t_3:4.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「...$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ has gone to sleep, then...」

443:t_3:5.en:
$$ハリー$$
「A pity. With a little more time, we could have heard the story about $$クロノ$$ as well.」

443:t_3:6.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「I'm certain that they will open the door to the truth with their own hands.」

443:t_3:7.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「$$ハリー$$... Apart from them, I have a favor to ask of you.」

443:t_3:8.en:
$$ハリー$$
「Please tell me whatever you require.」

443:t_3:9.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Once this battle is over, I intend to summon $$キエル$$ from Earth.」

443:t_3:11.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「I will bury the name of $$クロノ$$ together with myself... As for the rest, I will entrust the future of the $$ムーンレィス$$ to a wise person of my choosing.」

443:t_3:12.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「I ask you to serve as her protector.」

443:t_3:13.en:
$$ハリー$$
「Understood. But, Your Majesty, what of you...?」

443:t_3:14.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「I have lived too long. It is unnatural for a person, after all.」

443:t_3:15.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「It is more of a premonition, but I believe that once this battle ends, true peace will come to the world.」

443:t_3:17.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Yes... I will entrust $$キエル$$ with the plan to return to Earth, the long-cherished wish of the $$ムーンレィス$$.」

443:t_3:18.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「I am sure she can overcome the unhappy past and grant that wish by peaceful means.」

443:t_3:19.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「With that, the $$ソレル$$ family will vanish from the history of humankind.」

443:t_3:20.en:
$$ハリー$$
「Understood. Then allow me to accompany you until that time.」

443:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What's the matter, $$ミコノ$$? Everyone has begun preparing to sortie and intercept the $$宇宙怪獣$$, you know.」

443:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's because of that $$ミカゲ$$, isn't it.」

443:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The stirring of your heart when you fought $$ミカゲ$$... it produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

443:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's all right, $$ミコノ$$. I won't tell anyone.」

443:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is surely a problem you yourself must resolve. Please take your time and think it over.」

443:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(She has surely been agonizing ever since the $$時獄戦役$$, hasn't she.)

443:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Do your best, $$ミコノ$$... The only ones who can settle the feelings of 12,000 years... no, 24,000 years are you two.)

443:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... well, well, if it isn't $$ガロード$$ and $$ロラン$$...」

443:t_10:19.en:
$$ロラン$$
「What's the matter, $$ＡＧ$$? You're suddenly bowing and scraping...」

443:t_10:20.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Watch out, $$ロラン$$. When this guy acts like this, he's definitely plotting something.」

443:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all! This $$ＡＧ$$ would never dream of anything so presumptuous!」

443:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So please, spare me the $$サテライトキャノン$$ and the $$月光蝶$$.」

443:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, you see... the two of you, with Gundams carrying strategic-class weapons, have just gained even more power, so I simply have to butter you up as if my life depended on it...」

443:t_10:25.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That's not like you, acting like that.」

443:t_10:26.en:
$$ロラン$$
「He's right. Besides, it's not as if we fight over personal feelings.」

443:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course. ...Well, I suppose it's because you two are like that that you were entrusted with even more power.」

443:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I ask it of you too. Please use that power for the sake of humanity.」

443:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then allow me to test the resolve of you two. Let's give it our all again today...」

443:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, thank you very much! Ah, you two are so understanding, it's a great help.」

443:t_10:35.en:
$$ロラン$$
「We're sortieing right after this, you know.」

443:t_10:36.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Rather than have him cling to us for no reason, it's faster to just deal with him quickly and be done.」

443:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I won't be discouraged! Today I'm selling super-valuable goods dug up from the $$マウンテンサイクル$$ on the Moon!」

443:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
